newsitem.title: COMOROS: Comoros magistrate sacked over oil company probe.
newsitem.headline: Comoros magistrate sacked over oil company probe.

text.p: Comoros President Mohamed Taki has sacked an examining magistrate, Babia Idi Mohamed, who had been probing alleged irregularities in the powerful Comoros Oil Company, Radio Comoros reported on Saturday night.
The announcement said he had been sacked for summoning Justice Minister Ali Hassanaly without consulting the government.
Mohamed was one of three magistrates who have been investigating state-owned companies. Opposition sources said they believed he had been sacked after unearthing evidence of irregularities.
Earlier this month, Comoros magistrates staged a strike in protest against government interference in their work.
